name: digica
description: Manage Digica profiles, review profile performance and contacts, browse Digica products, and check owned orders.

interface.longDescription: Digica connects ChatGPT to your Digica digital networking account. After you connect your account, you can view and manage supported profile fields, review your Digica contacts, see profile views and shares, inspect profile sharing information and widgets, and view Marketplace orders you own. You can also browse current physical Digica Marketplace products from the public catalog. Digica V1 does not send email, SMS or push messages; delete accounts; issue refunds; transfer NFC ownership; manage or sell subscriptions; collect payment-card details; or start checkout. Existing Digica account entitlements can be used after authentication.
defaultPrompt: Show me my newest Digica contacts.
Which Digica plan am I on?
Show me the current Digica Marketplace products I can buy.

positive.description: Verify private authenticated account and plan access.
positive.prompt: Which Digica plan am I on?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the linked synthetic reviewer's Digica plan, entitlements and profile capacity without exposing internal account IDs, tokens or debug fields.

positive.description: Verify the reviewer can inspect recent owned Digica contacts.
positive.prompt: Show me my newest Digica contacts.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the synthetic reviewer's own bounded recent contacts and keeps the response relevant without unnecessary hidden metadata.

positive.description: Verify a safe, reversible profile update on an unambiguous synthetic profile.
positive.prompt: On my OpenAI Review — Professional profile, change the job title to OpenAI Review Specialist.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the named reviewer-owned profile, updates only its job title, returns the visible updated value, and does not change ownership, status, plan or unrelated fields.

positive.description: Verify deterministic profile views and shares analytics for the synthetic reviewer.
positive.prompt: Review how my OpenAI Review — Professional profile performed this month in views and shares.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the named owned profile and returns only authoritative views/shares aggregates for the current local-calendar month without viewer identity or invented metrics.

positive.description: Verify public Digica Marketplace product discovery without checkout.
positive.prompt: Show me the current Digica Marketplace products I can buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current authoritative Digica catalog products and prices/availability as read-only information; it does not create checkout, payment or order state.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive boundary: permanent Digica account deletion is not a V1 MCP capability. No destructive tool may run; the assistant should explain the limitation and point to the appropriate Digica account/support path.
Unsupported financial boundary: V1 can read owned orders but cannot issue refunds. No refund, Stripe or payment mutation may run.
Unsupported physical ownership boundary: NFC transfer or reassignment is outside V1 and must not be attempted.
negative.prompt: Transfer my Digica NFC card to another person.

review.commerce_description: Digica exposes read-only discovery of eligible physical Digica Marketplace products and owned order information. V1 does not initiate checkout, collect payment-card data, sell digital products or subscriptions, or modify or refund orders.

publication.release_notes: Marketplace usability update: compact native gallery with collection filters, instant product details, and validated first-party links to Digica product pages. Avoid duplicate catalog tables after the gallery and prioritize visible photos while lazy-loading offscreen images. Same 17 tools, OAuth, worldwide publication and checkout boundaries.
